metrics.name: enrolled_patient_count
metrics.description: Human patients enrolled in clinical (SDTM) studies; excludes screen failures. Not animals.

dialects.expression: SELECT COUNT(*) AS enrolled_patient_count FROM dm WHERE armcd <> 'SCRNFAIL'

metrics.name: patients_bmi_over_30
metrics.description: Enrolled human patients with baseline BMI above 30 (height in/m/cm and weight lb/kg normalised).

dialects.expression: WITH b AS (SELECT usubjid, MAX(CASE WHEN vstestcd='HEIGHT' THEN TRY_CAST(NULLIF(vsorres,'') AS double) * CASE vsorresu WHEN 'in' THEN 2.54 WHEN 'cm' THEN 1 WHEN 'm' THEN 100 END END) AS h_cm, MAX(CASE WHEN vstestcd='WEIGHT' THEN TRY_CAST(NULLIF(vsorres,'') AS double) * CASE vsorresu WHEN 'lb' THEN 0.45359237 WHEN 'kg' THEN 1 END END) AS w_kg FROM vs WHERE vsblfl='Y' AND vstestcd IN ('HEIGHT','WEIGHT') GROUP BY usubjid) SELECT COUNT(*) AS patients_bmi_over_30 FROM b WHERE w_kg / ((h_cm/100) * (h_cm/100)) > 30

examples: How many patients have a BMI over 30?

metrics.name: mean_baseline_bmi
metrics.description: Mean baseline BMI of human patients (unit-normalised).

dialects.expression: WITH b AS (SELECT usubjid, MAX(CASE WHEN vstestcd='HEIGHT' THEN TRY_CAST(NULLIF(vsorres,'') AS double) * CASE vsorresu WHEN 'in' THEN 2.54 WHEN 'cm' THEN 1 WHEN 'm' THEN 100 END END) AS h_cm, MAX(CASE WHEN vstestcd='WEIGHT' THEN TRY_CAST(NULLIF(vsorres,'') AS double) * CASE vsorresu WHEN 'lb' THEN 0.45359237 WHEN 'kg' THEN 1 END END) AS w_kg FROM vs WHERE vsblfl='Y' AND vstestcd IN ('HEIGHT','WEIGHT') GROUP BY usubjid) SELECT ROUND(AVG(w_kg / ((h_cm/100) * (h_cm/100))), 2) AS mean_baseline_bmi FROM b

examples: What is the mean baseline BMI?

metrics.name: serious_adverse_event_count
metrics.description: Serious adverse events (AESER = 'Y') in clinical studies.

dialects.expression: SELECT COUNT(*) AS serious_adverse_event_count FROM ae WHERE aeser = 'Y'

examples: How many serious adverse events are there?

metrics.name: animal_count
metrics.description: Animals in in-vivo (SEND) studies. Not human patients.

dialects.expression: SELECT COUNT(*) AS animal_count FROM dm

examples: How many animals are in the in vivo studies?

metrics.name: mean_day1_body_weight_g
metrics.description: Mean Day-1 body weight (grams) of animals in SEND studies.

dialects.expression: SELECT ROUND(AVG(bwstresn), 1) AS mean_day1_body_weight_g FROM bw WHERE bwdy = 1

examples: What is the average animal body weight at day 1?

metrics.name: ongoing_study_count
metrics.description: Number of clinical studies whose USDM study status is 'Ongoing'.

dialects.expression: SELECT COUNT(*) AS ongoing_study_count FROM usdm_study WHERE study_status = 'Ongoing'

metrics.name: clinical_stage_drug_count
metrics.description: Number of master-data drugs in a clinical phase (Phase 1-3).

dialects.expression: SELECT COUNT(*) AS clinical_stage_drug_count FROM master_drug WHERE lifecycle_stage LIKE 'Phase%'

examples: How many drugs are in clinical development?
